next_step: Deliver TCO + latency validation run; schedule architecture workshop wk of 2025-02-12
notes:
Top-line: large enterprise search vendor for financial docs + enterprise knowledge; strong focus on cost/unit and reranking latency for customer-facing search. POC results and architecture notes below.

- Background: built internal vector platform (homegrown) but costs exploded at 600M vectors; looking to offload serving/runtime + routing.
- Scale target: 600M active vectors initially, plan to 1B+ in 18 months. Mixed modalities (text embeddings + document metadata). Expect steady ingestion of ~6-10M vectors/month.
- Performance targets: end-to-end reranked query (embedding retrieval + neural reranker) p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for single-shard user queries. SLA requirement for latency-sensitive features (customer search).
- Cost targets: target query unit cost <$0.0005 (amortized across retrieval + rerank). Need batching/caching recommendations to reach this.
- POC highlights (Jan 2025): ingested ~620M precomputed vectors into Redwood Dedicated POC cluster. Observed: raw ANN recall OK; neural reranker add-on increased tail latency (p99 ~260ms). With prefix KV caching + 64-request batching saw p95 drop to 118ms but p99 remained ~190ms.
- Quote: CTO "we need sub-100ms for 95th in prod — anything above that kills UX" (pushing for aggressive caching + hybrid rerank).
- Security/compliance: EU residency for some customers; must support VPC peering, customer KMS, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. Legal has heavy redlines on data residency and retention periods.
- Integration: currently uses Spark + Flink ingestion pipeline, existing embeddings using OpenAI/cheap local models; wants ability to run quantized models and fallback routing by policy.
- Wants: clear TCO at 600M/1B scale, recommended batching/caching config per QPS profile, quantization and kernel-profile suggestions, canary rollout pattern for model changes, and regression monitoring for embedding drift.
- Procurement notes: procurement team asks for 3-year committed pricing and reserved capacity option. Will push Dedicated or Private depending on SLA and price.
- Next steps agreed on call: Redwood to run a focused latency validation run (reranker + retrieval) with recommended cache sizes; deliver TCO model and JSON-based security questionnaire. Workshop with infra + security scheduled.
- Pain points: current platform costs >2x expected, no reliable fallback when reranker overloaded, issues with index compaction causing query slowdowns.

Short handshake notes: meeting 2025-01-22 — demo + initial POC handoff. 2025-01-30 — follow-up engineering deep dive (notes in drive). 2025-02-04 — legal kickoff (security faq sent).
